# Third-party notices

New campaign code is licensed under Apache-2.0. Source documents and datasets do
not inherit that license. See source-specific provenance and reuse conditions.

## Dynamical CLI

The dependency `dynamical-cli==0.1.22` is Apache-2.0. Its source contracts provide
requirements, prospective references, instrument and evidence records. This repo
does not redistribute the historical installed HPMS runtime or its asset bundle.
Any proposed upstream patch is explicit and separately reviewed. The dependency's
own notices continue to apply to its bundled third-party materials.

## Pi

The separately installed, pinned Pi 0.85.1 packages declare MIT. Their notices
remain with the npm distribution. Campaign-owned transport adaptations are not
the Pi package. See the exact npm lock and adaptation provenance before release.

## Historical campaign infrastructure

Selected campaign-owned scientific-state and transport patterns are adapted from
the preserved 2026-09-11 NdFeB implementation. Its world model, calibration corpus,
private credentials, run archives and installed authority are not copied. The
historical campaign root had no standalone license declaration; public release
requires owner confirmation of rights for any adapted code, recorded in REUSE.md.

## Scientific sources

Public accessibility is not a blanket redistribution license. Numerical source
facts, original documents, derived figures and raw datasets have separate provenance.
Unresolved or restricted assets stay outside the public package. No claim is made
that possession of a paper licenses commercial training on its text.
